$comment: Reviewed exceptions for the click specs (tests/e2e/specs/clicks). Every entry needs a reason a reviewer agrees with.
inert: '<screen key>#<control id>' -> reason, for a control that is meant to do nothing (every-control.spec.ts).
links: '<screen key>#<link code>' -> reason, for a designed link the screen deliberately does not follow (designed-links.spec.ts).
Control ids are printed in the report: lk:<code>, testid:<id>, or <role>:<accessible name> (digits shown as #). '*' matches anything.
ignoreConsole / ignoreHttp: { pattern (regular expression, case-insensitive), reason }. HTTP text is '<status> <METHOD> <url>'.
Judge-walkthrough screens (README.md) may not appear in inert or links: the spec fails if they do.
